{{External|rs=Scarab swarm}} {{HasTask|Scabarites}} {{Confuse|Scarabs}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = Normal |version2 = Pyramid Plunder |name = Scarab Swarm |image = [[File:Scarab Swarm.png|250px]] |release1 = [[26 April]] [[2005]] |release2 = [[17 July]] [[2006]] |update1 = Desert Month Finale |update2 = Pyramid Plunder |members = Yes |combat = 98 |size = 1 |examine = I think they're some kind of beetle. |attributes = kalphite |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 1 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = Yes (3) |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 1 |slayxp = 1 |cat = Scabarites |assignedby = nieve |hitpoints = 25 |att = 255 |str = 5 |def = 30 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 90 |dslash = 90 |dcrush = 5 |dmagic = 90 |dlight = 90 |dstandard = 90 |dheavy = 90 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 50 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 4192 |id2 = 1782 |leagueRegion = Desert }} '''Scarab swarms''' are swarms of [[poison]]ous scarab beetles. Although their max hit is low, they are highly accurate with an extremely fast [[attack speed]] and are very likely to poison any players that they attack. They can crawl up from the ground randomly in some pyramid areas (such as [[Sophanem Dungeon]] when stepping on the sand pit [[floor (Sophanem Dungeon)|floor trap]], and have a chance of spawning when the gold chest is opened in [[Pyramid Plunder]]. When spawning in Pyramid Plunder, the player will take an unavoidable instance of damage from failing the chest; subsequent normal attack damage from the scarab is preventable with Protect from Melee. They are only [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] to the player that caused them to spawn. Once that player leaves, the scarab swarm will ignore other players and eventually despawn. The scarab swarms that spawn in the [[Ancient Pyramid]] are simply known as [[Scarabs]]. While they have a lower [[combat level]], they have the same appearance and behaviour. ==Locations== *[[Pyramid Plunder]] *[[Sophanem Dungeon]] *[[Klenter's Pyramid]] ==Drops== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 27 April 2022 |update = Beneath Cursed Sands |change = The NPC was renamed from "Scarab swarm" to "Scarab Swarm". }} {{Subject changes |date = 24 September 2015 |update = New Animations & Barbarian Assault Changes |change = Scarab Swarms should no longer follow you outside of Pyramid Plunder. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 16 May –
13 June 2006 |change = The NPC was renamed from "Scarabs" to "Scarab swarm". }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Strangely, even though [[scarabs]] do not drop anything, and despite these swarms consisting of a group of insects, scarab swarms drop bones on death. {{Contact!}} {{Beneath Cursed Sands}} {{Pyramid Plunder}} {{Pyramids}}
